name: x2611_10200_thm1_2
original: For all $g,k\geq 1$ , one has $M_{g+1,k}>M_{g,k}$ . Consequently, if $[1^{g},0^{k},N]$ is complete, then $[1^{g+1},0^{k},N]$ is complete.
type: ∀ (g k : ℕ), 1 ≤ g → 1 ≤ k → Mathlib2.x2611_10200_M g k < Mathlib2.x2611_10200_M (g + 1) k ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ), 1 ≤ N → ∀ (H H' : ℕ → ℤ), Mathlib2.x2611_10200_standard g k N H → Mathlib2.x2611_10200_standard (g + 1) k N H' → Mathlib2.x2611_10200_complete H → Mathlib2.x2611_10200_complete H'
